nfe_definition: Mean per-image cumulative selection NFE across all adaptive batches: (DiffPIR steps - 1) × O scenarios × ceil((M_final-M_initial)/batch_size). Final F decoding NFE is excluded.
important_scope: All values are equal-weight means over 9 native 256×256 and 2 native 512×512 Set11 images. T ablations change both O and F DiffPIR steps in the archived experiments; the x-axis nevertheless includes O selection NFE only.
